title: Improvement of dielectric and structural characteristics of Nanofiller (Ba0.92Sr0.08 )TiO3 Ceramics combined with epoxy as composites for dielectric purposes
title_zh: 纳米填料 (Ba0.92Sr0.08 )TiO3 陶瓷与环氧树脂相结合作为介电用途复合材料的介电和结构特性的改善
summary: 聚合物纳米复合材料是通过用钛酸钡 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 增强环氧树脂而制成的，具有高介电强度。这些复合材料的介电能力受时间、温度和浓度的影响而发生显着变化。该研究深入研究了环氧树脂复合材料，探讨了 BST 纳米粒子的比例如何影响环氧树脂长径比的介电强度。
abstract: Polymer Nano composites were created by reinforcing epoxy with barium titanate (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3, boasting high dielectric strength. These composites showcased significant alterations in their dielectric capabilities, influenced by time, temperature, and concentration. The research delved into epoxy resin composites, exploring how the ratio of BST nanoparticles affected the dielectric strength concerning the epoxy aspect ratio. Epoxy was combined with nano filler titanate (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 Ceramics at various BST to epoxy ratios of 0%, 2.5%, 5%, 7%, and 100%, with the mixture left to cure in an oven at temperatures of 40°C, 50°C, 60°C, and 80°C for durations ranging from 10 to 50 minutes. The temperature was consistently set at 50°C, while curing times varied from 10 to 50 minutes. The study also delved into the mechanical bonding mechanisms between BST and epoxy polymer. Techniques such as Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) were employed to study delaminated layers, inspect fracture surfaces, and assess structural features and dielectric strength. Discussions revolved around the impacts of concentration, particle size, and BST filler on the dielectric properties of BST/polymer composites. Artificial Neural Networks, known as ANNs, mimic the intricate workings of the human brain to delve into the realms of ceramic/polymer composites' dielectric constants and the crafting of BST/polymer composites. Delving deeper, the enhancement of dielectric constants in BST/polymer composites is succinctly outlined. A novel theoretical model focusing on dielectric constants, drawn from our prior research endeavors, is presented. Furthermore, the impacts of various factors on the dielectric constants of these composites are explored, aiding in the forecast of their dielectric constants. This discussion holds significant theoretical and research implications for future endeavors.

title: Fabrication of Waterborne Polyurethane Flexible Strain Sensors Based on KH560-MXene/MWCNTs Synergistic Effects and the Application in Motion Posture Monitoring
title_zh: 基于KH560-MXene/MWCNTs协同效应的水性聚氨酯柔性应变传感器的制备及其在运动姿态监测中的应用
summary: 柔性传感器作为可穿戴电子产品和智能健康监测设备的核心部件，在人体生理信号采集和运动行为检测等领域具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，柔性传感材料普遍存在环境稳定性差、传感信号抗干扰能力弱、长期循环运行不可避免地导致传感性能下降等问题，严重制约了其大规模实际应用。为了解决这些问题，采用水性聚氨酯（WPU）作为柔性基质，引入带有KH560的改性MXene纳米片和多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）作为混合导电填料。通过溶液混合和铸造策略制造集成的高性能柔性应变传感器。
abstract: Flexible sensors serve as the core component of wearable electronics and intelligent health monitoring devices, possessing enormous application potential in the fields of human physiological signal acquisition and motion behavior detection. Nevertheless, flexible sensing materials generally suffer from poor environmental stability, weak anti-interference capability of sensing signals, and inevitable degradation of sensing performance during long-term cyclic operation, which severely restrict their large-scale practical applications. To address these issues, waterborne polyurethane (WPU) is adopted as the flexible matrix, modified MXene nanosheets with KH560 and multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) were introduced as hybrid conductive fillers. An integrated high-performance flexible strain sensor is fabricated via a solution blending and casting strategy. Through hydrogen bonding and electrostatic adsorption effects, a 1D-2D interconnected conductive network is constructed, where MXene acts as the primary conductive unit and MWCNTs function as interconnection bridging segments. This flexible sensor based on the composite system exhibits superior comprehensive performances, including a high gauge factor of 2.81, a broad strain detection range of 0-2800%, rapid response and recovery times of 150 ms and 120 ms, as well as excellent cycling stability over 3000 cycles. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations elucidate the interfacial mechanism of the MXene/MWCNTs heterojunction, verifying that the sensing mechanism originates from the synergistic effect of band structure evolution and conductive network reconstruction. Furthermore, the sensor enables real-time monitoring of electromyographic signals during human movements, demonstrating great application potential in intelligent wearable electronics.

title: Quantum Cointegration: Common Trends and Ordered Correlations
title_zh: 量子协整：共同趋势和有序相关性
summary: 对比可以消除常见的随机趋势，但仍然留下部分残差无法识别。对于自伴量子过程，相同的消除会产生短记忆残差，但该残差的对称协方差不会修复时间排序的乘积。在模型（Zₜ⁽σ⁾=Qₜ+σ Pₜ₋₁）中，两个符号都具有对称谱（f(θ)=1）和有序谱（S_σ(θ)=1-σsinθ）。一个新副本的真实线性对比度具有独立于 (σ) 的定律。有序 Weyl 见证 (w(eⁱuZₜeⁱvZₜ₋₁)) 的虚部随 (σ) 改变符号。
abstract: A contrast can remove a common stochastic trend and still leave part of the residual unidentified. For a self-adjoint quantum process, the same cancellation produces a short-memory residual, but the symmetric covariance of that residual does not fix the time-ordered products. In the model (Zₜ⁽σ⁾=Qₜ+σ Pₜ₋₁), both signs have symmetric spectrum (f(θ)=1) and ordered spectrum (S_σ(θ)=1-σsinθ). A real linear contrast of one fresh copy has a law independent of (σ). The imaginary part of the ordered Weyl witness (w(eⁱuZₜeⁱvZₜ₋₁)) changes sign with (σ). A finite-dimensional simulation of an idealized differential sensor reproduces the common-trend cancellation, the equality of the real-contrast laws, and the sign of the ordered witness. The simulation is not a hardware measurement, and it does not establish a gain in sensor precision. The statements apply to the processes, initial conditions, and instruments named with them. Full assumptions, proofs, counterexamples, and numerical qualifications are included in the appendices to make the operator and recorded-data claims separately auditable.

title: Unstable plasma heats itself with waves it generates, experiments reveal
title_zh: 实验表明，不稳定的等离子体通过产生的波加热自身
summary: 聚变发电有望成为一种可持续能源，在发电过程中不排放二氧化碳。为了实现这一目标，世界各地正在进行利用磁场限制高温等离子体的研究。为了引发聚变反应，必须从外部注入高能粒子或波，将等离子体加热到极高的温度。
abstract: Fusion power is expected to be a sustainable energy source that emits no carbon dioxide during electricity generation. To achieve this, research is underway worldwide to confine high-temperature plasma using magnetic fields. To initiate a fusion reaction, high-energy particles or waves must be injected from outside to heat the plasma to extremely high temperatures.

title: Impact of in vitro exposure to 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz fields on human forebrain organoids
title_zh: 体外暴露于 5G 调制 3.5 GHz 场对人类前脑类器官的影响
summary: 5G 移动技术的发展使人们暴露在 3.5 GHz 的电磁场中，引发了人们对其对人类大脑发育影响的担忧。大多数关于射频对大脑影响的研究都使用啮齿类动物，尽管人类和啮齿类动物的皮质生成之间存在重大差异，包括祖细胞亚型和成熟时间。在这里，40 天大的人类前脑类器官（具有活跃增殖的顶端和基底神经祖细胞）暴露于 5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频，平均比吸收率 (SAR) 为 1.5 W/kg。
abstract: The development of 5G mobile technology exposes populations to electromagnetic fields at 3.5 GHz, raising concerns about their effects on human brain development. Most studies on the cerebral effects of radiofrequencies have used rodents, despite major differences between human and rodent corticogenesis, including progenitor subtypes and maturation timing. Here, 40-day-old human forebrain organoids, with actively proliferating apical and basal neural progenitors, were exposed to 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz radiofrequencies at an average specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.5 W/kg. Effects on neural and glial development were assessed at 7 and 13 weeks using immunocytochemistry and RNA sequencing. Exposed and control organoids showed comparable size and morphology. Progenitor subtype identity and number, proliferation, and apoptotic death rates were similar at both stages. No significant differences were observed in the proportions of cortical neurons, oligodendrocytes, or astrocytes. Transcriptomic analysis confirmed neuronal maturation from 7 to 13 weeks but revealed no significant change in gene expression following exposure. These findings suggest that, under the in vitro conditions tested, 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz radiofrequencies have no major effect on human forebrain organoid development.

title: PEC-backed absorber for multiband applications ranging from 8 GHz to 40 GHz
title_zh: 适用于 8 GHz 至 40 GHz 多频段应用的 PEC 支持吸收器
summary: 在本文中，提出了一种紧凑的多环超表面，用于在 8-40 GHz 的宽频率范围内进行多凹口传输。该结构由不同半径的同心开环谐振器和辅助耦合环组成，其中谐振响应由谐振元件之间的有效电感、电容和电磁耦合控制。该设计经过九阶段的演变，并使用等效耦合 RLC 模型来解释观察到的共振的起源。该结构在 TE 和 TM 偏振下也表现出类似的响应，表明对偏振不敏感的行为。此外，还研究了超表面层之间的堆叠、相对位移、气隙分离和旋转的影响，证明了对谐振传输特性的额外控制。
abstract: In this paper, a compact multi-ring metasurface is proposed for multi-notch transmission over a wide frequency range of 8–40 GHz. The structure consists of concentric split-ring resonators with different radii and auxiliary coupling rings, where the resonant response is controlled by the effective inductance, capacitance, and electromagnetic coupling between the resonating elements. The design is developed through a nine-stage evolution, and an equivalent coupled-RLC model is used to explain the origin of the observed resonances. The structure also exhibits similar responses under TE and TM polarizations, indicating polarization-insensitive behavior. Further, the effects of stacking, relative displacement, air-gap separation, and rotation between metasurface layers are investigated, demonstrating additional control over the resonant transmission characteristics.
